THE_ARCHITECT.talk.HOLLOWKNIGHT-HOLLOW_K: Another hollow thing comes to my door.
DARV.talk.HOLLOWKNIGHT-HOLLOW_KNIGHT.1-0: You again, little one. Darv is in a good mood today!
DARV.talk.HOLLOWKNIGHT-HOLLOW_KNIGHT.1-1: Look around, pick anything - as long as you can pay in Geo!
NEOW.talk.HOLLOWKNIGHT-HOLLOW_KNIGHT.1-0: On the road again, little vessel. May your soul guide you.
NONUPEIPE.talk.HOLLOWKNIGHT-HOLLOW_KNIGH: Welcome back, quiet friend. Only fine goods today!
TANX.talk.HOLLOWKNIGHT-HOLLOW_KNIGHT.1-0: You again? Seems your shell is harder than I thought.
VAKUU.talk.HOLLOWKNIGHT-HOLLOW_KNIGHT.1-: Back again? Let's see what story you bring this time.
OROBAS.talk.HOLLOWKNIGHT-HOLLOW_KNIGHT.1: Hm? You again. The ledger remembers, little vessel.
PAEL.talk.HOLLOWKNIGHT-HOLLOW_KNIGHT.1-0: Here again? Remember: the price always hides behind the sweetest promise.
TEZCATARA.talk.HOLLOWKNIGHT-HOLLOW_KNIGH: Fate entwines us again, little vessel.
DARV.talk.HOLLOWKNIGHT-HOLLOW_KNIGHT.0-1: (Darv rummages through his goods and holds out an empty jar.)
DARV.talk.HOLLOWKNIGHT-HOLLOW_KNIGHT.0-2: No talking? That's fine - Darv likes quiet customers. Take whatever you need!
NEOW.talk.HOLLOWKNIGHT-HOLLOW_KNIGHT.0-1: Oh? A silent little vessel. May you find what you seek in these lands.
NONUPEIPE.talk.HOLLOWKNIGHT-HOLLOW_KNIGH: What a curious guest! No mouth, yet gratitude written all over that face.
TANX.talk.HOLLOWKNIGHT-HOLLOW_KNIGHT.0-1: Ha! A little thing that stares back. I like it. Don't disappoint me.
VAKUU.talk.HOLLOWKNIGHT-HOLLOW_KNIGHT.0-: A courteous traveler. Out here, courtesy is a rare currency.
OROBAS.talk.HOLLOWKNIGHT-HOLLOW_KNIGHT.0: Don't be afraid, little one. I don't bite - unless you owe me.
PAEL.talk.HOLLOWKNIGHT-HOLLOW_KNIGHT.0-1: A wing for a wing, a soul for a soul. You'll learn the art of the trade.
TEZCATARA.talk.HOLLOWKNIGHT-HOLLOW_KNIGH: Hollow eyes, yet a heart that isn't. Interesting. Very interesting.
